scenes.text: Imagine being the only tree for over two hundred and fifty miles in every single direction, completely alone in the harsh Sahara desert.
This was the Tree of Ténéré, a miracle of survival that served as a vital landmark for travelers by rooting eighty feet below the sand.
But in nineteen-seventy-three, a truck driver allegedly managed to drive across hundreds of miles of flat land and crash directly into it.
With the tree knocked down and gone forever, hit follow and tell me your thoughts on this bizarre tragedy below!
